title: Zesty Slovakian Potato Dumplings
description: A spicy, pillowy Slovakian dish featuring cayenne pepper and a brine-wet finish, dairy-free and comforting.
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes into 1 cm cubes, then place them in a pot of boiling water and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash them until smooth, then let them cool until they are warm but not hot.
Stir in salt, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, and chopped dill into the warm mashed potatoes until evenly combined.
Gradually fold in the flour, adding just enough to form a pliable dough that does not stick to fingers, about 60 grams total.
Shape the dough into small dumplings, roughly 3 cm in diameter, using a spoon or your hands, and place them on a lightly oiled tray.
Fill a large pot with water, bring to a rolling boil, and carefully drop the dumplings in, cooking until they float to the surface plus an extra 2 minutes, about 12 minutes total.
While the dumplings cook, prepare a spicy sauce by heating olive oil in a skillet, adding a pinch of cayenne pepper, and stirring for 30 seconds.
Pour the hot sauce over the cooked dumplings, toss gently to coat, and serve immediately with a splash of lemon juice if desired.
Optionally garnish with additional fresh dill or chopped parsley before serving.
